description.narrative: The most significant, expected Project-level outcome is increased access to sustainable assets, housing loans and SME finance. Beyond this outcome, IFC anticipates the investment will promote sustainable financing in Guatemala through an innovative financial instrument. The Project will support the first issuance of a sustainable DPR by a bank, paving the way for other FIs to carry out similar issuances.

The proposed project (the Project) consists of a sustainable Diversified Payments Rights (DPR) notes issuance of up to US$200 million by Banco G&T Continental (GTC or the Bank), an IFC client since 2008, in Guatemala. The investment will be executed under the Banks existing DPR program and through a Special Purpose Corporation (Titularizadora Centro Americana de DPRs or the SPC). The sustainable notes will be collateralized by US-denominated DPRs originated by GTC and will have a tenor of 7 years, with a 2-year grace period. The use of proceeds of the investment is to support GTCs loan portfolio growth in (i) climate-related assets, including green buildings and energy-efficiency sub-projects; (ii) Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in accordance with IFCs definition and applicable local regulation; and (iii) low-income housing, with a specific carve out to support women home ownership. The aforementioned use of proceeds will comply with applicable Guatemalan Regulations, including E&S requirements.
